title: Warm Buttery Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: A cozy Argentinian dish featuring beef skewers cooked in a wok with buttery infuse-oil and tomato ketchup, perfect for a cold evening. This Mediterranean-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the wok over medium-high heat.
Thread the beef strips onto the soaked wooden skewers.
In a small bowl, mix together the butter, infuse-oil, tomato ketchup, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto the beef skewers.
Add the skewers to the preheated wok and cook for 5 minutes per side.
Repeat the cooking process until the beef is cooked to a safe internal temperature of 145 degrees.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
